build_deepseek_vl2_model: build a Deepseek-VL2 multimodal causal language model with vLLM config and vision-language processing pipeline
create_mlp_projector: create an MLP projector module that transforms vision features to language model embedding space with downsampling
create_multimodal_processor: create a multimodal processor that handles image token replacement and batched field configuration for Deepseek-VL2
run_deepseek_vl2_forward: run inference on Deepseek-VL2 model with input_ids, positions, and optional image embeddings
load_deepseek_vl2_weights: load HuggingFace-compatible weights into Deepseek-VL2 model with automatic prefix remapping
